build_prompts_from_parsed_book: build prompts for a parsed textbook using the build_prompts function with a specified audience style
parse_chapter_recursively: parse a textbook chapter and its nested sub-chapters recursively using parse_chapter
parse_book_structure: parse an openstax book into structured chapters and sections using parse_book
run_prompt_pipeline: run the full prompt generation pipeline for openstax books and push the dataset to HuggingFace Hub
review_styles_dict: review the STYLES dictionary to understand prompt templates for young children, middle school, college, and professional audiences
